UI_HBRShared_Option_Tooltip: Which item marks you see. Only mine: your own marks, like the original mod. Whole server: your marks plus the list shared by all players. My faction: your marks plus your faction's list. In the shared modes, marking or unmarking an item (also with auto-mark) updates that list for everyone. Your own marks are always kept, so you can go back to Only mine at any time.
